status: Three exact lower-vowel additions approved after original-pixel comparison and independent challenge; nine selected notes retained
applicationState: pendingRootIntegration; no canonical, central approval, daily, presentation or generated file modified by this report
method: Bounded new study of twelve remaining annotated WIS lower-vowel sites, within chapters that still contain annotations. Original embedded A2 pixels only; native crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. Full words and numbered source rows verify addresses, including printed6/8 mapping to Catholic19:5/19:7. Literal detached three-node qubbuts and flat mem-patah anchors establish point classes; same-font sheva, qamats, tsere and same-page mem-segol compete with the target contours. Connected ink does not preclude a readable surviving shape, but merged blocks without a unique class remain disclosed. No OCR, grammatical expectation, translation, enhancement, new scan witness or blank-cavity inference supplies a mark. Algorithms verify provenance and exact source conservation, not vowel readings. Historical reports remain immutable.
contentAfterHashMeaning: Expected WIS source-content digest after only the three approved exact-letter additions, their note retirements and one retained-anchor refresh; root supplies later review-history/central metadata.

independentReview.root: Separately accepted both exact qubbuts contours after target/word/detached-positive/sheva comparisons. Separately accepted3:12 patah after the flat positive, qamats/tsere competitors and requested same-page mem-segol counter. Explicit final three/nine decision preceded publication.
independentReview.SIRPeer: Independently accepted the two qubbuts after exact native replay and same-page pointed/plain challenges; independently accepted the3:12 patah after original replay and full positive/counter words. Verified source printed12 and the printed6/8 to Catholic19:5/19:7 mapping.
independentReview.BELPeer: Independently accepted both qubbuts after target/fullword, detached alef-qubbuts, mem-sheva and homologous shin comparisons.

Those competing contours are absent here. Certify literal patah solely from the surviving bar geometry.

inspections.finding: A heavy foot and a round lower extension survive, but the added mark is not sufficiently distinct from a merged qamats head/stem or joined sheva. The same-font pointed-kaf comparisons show that foot-plus-lower-lobe geometry alone cannot decide the vowel. Retain the complete disclosure.

The mem has an already complete lower foot and a separate shallow continuous bar, joined to it only at the left. Its lower contour is flat apart from a one-pixel end lug. The literal detached mem-patah in13:10 has the same broad shallow bar; the3:19 mem-qamats has a substantial central descending stem, the13:3 mem-tsere retains two lobes and a window, and the SAME-PAGE4:2 second mem-segol has a triangular third lower projection and window. Those competing contours are absent here. Certify literal patah solely from the surviving bar geometry.

The lower region is a saturated block with two small low tips. A second point, a short stem or a merged edge could be absorbed into it. The literal patah/tsere/qamats comparisons do not make this target uniquely classifiable. Retain the note.
The broad bet foot and lower mass have coalesced; there is no independent bar, pair or three-node contour sufficient to distinguish the competing lower vowels. Retain the note.

Two lower swellings suggest a vertical pair, but the upper swelling is not cleanly distinguishable from a broad merged vowel head or the kaf foot. Same-page pointed-kaf forms show how a head plus lower stem/lobe can mimic this outline. Do not classify sheva or qamats by expectation; retain.
The bet lower block is broad and almost rectangular with small tips, without a separable point pattern. Neither a flat bar nor multiple dots can be uniquely recovered from the saturated foot. Retain.

The lower mass contains a white notch but has two broad attachments to the foot; the surviving contour does not distinguish a merged pair, triangle or bar with an irregular foot. The complete corrected target frame preserves the entire letter, without resolving the mark. Retain.
The bet lower edge is a solid merged block. The source preserves no sufficiently separate bar, central stem or rounded pair to certify one vowel. Retain.

A wide lower mass and tiny bottom spur survive, but the mass is substantially fused across the foot. Unlike the3:12 shallow bar, the target does not preserve a sufficiently discriminating upper/lower contour to eliminate a merged triangle, pair or stem. Retain.

The single broad rounded lower extension is contiguous with the mem foot and lacks diagnostic internal structure. A natural heavy foot plus one point cannot be separated from multiple merged points. Retain.
